prompt: Create a 3x3 grid of nine stylized digital portrait avatars on a clean white background, all depicting the same young man with curly dark brown hair, a trimmed beard and mustache, and a soul patch under his lower lip. He wears a charcoal gray suit jacket over a crisp white collared shirt. The art style is smooth, semi-realistic 3D rendering reminiscent of modern app profile pictures, with soft studio lighting and gentle skin shading. Arrange the nine heads in three rows to show different gaze directions: top row looking upward (left, center, right), middle row looking straight ahead or slightly sideways at eye level, bottom row looking downward. Keep facial features consistent across all nine panels while varying only head angle and eye direction.

promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上创建一个 3x3 的九宫格风格化数字肖像头像，所有头像均描绘同一位年轻男性：深棕色卷发、修剪整齐的胡须和八字胡，以及下唇下方的一撮山羊胡。他身穿炭灰色西装外套，内搭挺括的白色翻领衬衫。艺术风格为平滑、半写实的 3D 渲染，类似于现代应用中的个人资料图片，采用柔和的影棚灯光和细腻的皮肤阴影处理。将九个头像排列成三行以展示不同的视线方向：顶行向上看（左、中、右），中行平视前方或略微侧视，底行向下看。保持所有九个面板中的面部特征一致，仅改变头部角度和眼睛方向。
